description: This class models the frequency of an Order in the OpenMRS system, representing how often an action should be repeated, such as 'TWICE DAILY' or 'EVERY 6 HOURS'. It extends metadata classes and is linked with concepts for internationalization and detailed descriptions.

classes.name: OrderFrequency
classes.description: Represents the frequency at which an order is repeated, backed by a Concept for internationalization and additional metadata.

methods.name: getOrderFrequencyId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this order frequency.

methods.name: setOrderFrequencyId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this order frequency.

methods.name: getFrequencyPerDay
methods.description: Returns the number of times per day this order should be carried out.

methods.name: setFrequencyPerDay
methods.description: Sets the number of times per day this order should be carried out.

methods.name: getUuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the order frequency.

methods.name: setUuid
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the order frequency.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID, alias for getOrderFrequencyId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID, alias for setOrderFrequencyId.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the Concept associated with this order frequency.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Associates a Concept with this order frequency.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name from the associated Concept, if available.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description from the associated Concept, if available.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the order frequency for display purposes.
